column1: # Canonical language table for the video-encoder scripts.
# Single source of truth — do not duplicate this data anywhere else.
#   - lang_table.sh (bash loader, sourced by encoder_params.sh and rename_plex.sh)
#   - encoder_params.sh's Python probe step (read directly, see probe_file())
# Format: tab-separated, one language per line.
#   code3   — primary 3-letter code (ISO 639-2). Used as the -l/SUB_LANGS key
#             and as the LANG_TABLE key consumed by encoder_params.sh.
#   code2   — 2-letter code (ISO 639-1). Used for Plex-convention sidecar
#   label   — display label used in track titles and renamer output.
#   aliases — comma-separated alternate codes that should resolve to this
#             language (e.g. bibliographic ISO 639-2/B variants), or "-" if
#             none. Used by rename_plex.sh's language normalization and by
#             the Python probe step's label lookup; NOT valid values for -l
#             (the primary code3 is the only accepted -l value).
# Adding a language: add one row here. Both bash and Python consumers pick it
# up automatically — nothing else in either script needs to change.
